verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server that exposes much of the core mailbox surface: listing and fetching threads, search and label filtering, composing, drafting and sending, deleting, bulk archive and delete, read/unread, and label create/modify/delete, plus AI compose and Q&A. However, it never claims or shows parity with the UI, and authentication currently means copying a browser session cookie, with OAuth listed as coming soon. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API or a stated UI-parity guarantee, programmatic access to settings and account/provider connection, proper API auth (OAuth or API keys), and independent hands-on corroboration.
